description: Source code for configuration loader in Playwright, including functions for loading, validating, and resolving configuration files, as well as defining configuration objects.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Defines a configuration object, merging multiple configs and marking that defineConfig was used.

methods.name: deserializeConfig
methods.description: Deserializes a serialized configuration into a full internal config object.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and validates a Playwright configuration from a specified location, applying overrides and handling ESM loader setup.

methods.name: loadConfigFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file, resolving its location and applying overrides.

methods.name: loadEmptyConfigForMergeReports
methods.description: Loads an empty configuration for report merging, avoiding local config from current directory.
